items.title: Ellis Marsalis interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Orleans, Louisiana, January 7, 2020
items.q: I started thinking about exactly how similar that situation was to Caesar telling all of the people to go back to where you were so that they could be taxed.

ctx.x: You know, to Los Angeles. And we stayed at a little place in East L.A. — I don’t remember much about it. It wasn’t a lot. We didn’t have a lot of money anyway. But eventually Harold — I don’t know — no, he didn’t stay, not at that time. But I don’t know when he came back because my mom tracked me down and said well your dad is not feeling good and you need to come home. So there was a guy I knew who had gone to school with my future wife who was coming back to New Orleans so I hitched a ride with him. So when I…
Was there a concern about going to Korea?
